mentions.name: Tetris - Plant Piece Edition
mentions.description: A Tetris variant called "Tetris - Plant Piece Edition" that adds a single growing "plant" piece: a 1x1 square that, once placed, grows one unit taller with each subsequent piece placed (1x1, then 2x1, then 3x1, etc.), getting out of control if unmanaged. Built with the help of Claude Code, with plans to host it in the coming week.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made "Tetris - Plant Piece Edition" using the help of the Claude Code. I hope to have it hosted in the coming week, I'm just so lazy with hosting and those type of things nowadays.

Essentially, this Tetris variant adds one change: a single 1x1 square that once placed, every turn it "grows up" by one. That is, once you place it, it will be a 1x1 square. Once you place the next piece, it will be a 2x1 piece. Then after the next piece it will be a 3x1 tall piece.
mentions.author: butlike
